fields.description: HTTPS site root only, e.g. https://yoursite.m.erpnext.com
fields.label: Cloud Site URL

fields.description: API key of a dedicated integration user on the cloud site.
fields.label: Cloud API Key

fields.description: Custom field on the cloud Sales Invoice / Customer / Address / Item that holds the duplicate-check key. sap_b1_key is the field the SAP B1 Web Portal already uses.
fields.label: Cloud Key Field

fields.description: Short code for this local site, used in cloud keys of invoices that did not come from SAP ("{code}|SINV-0001"). Never change it after the first push.
fields.label: Local Site Code

fields.description: No call of any kind is made to the cloud site until this or 'Allow production' is checked. E-invoice / e-way bill actions additionally require the cloud's GST Settings to be in sandbox mode.
fields.label: I confirm the cloud site is a TEST / SANDBOX site

fields.description: Allows e-invoice / e-way bill actions against a cloud site whose GST Settings are NOT in sandbox mode, i.e. the live GST portal. Only check this after the sandbox test checklist has passed.
fields.label: Allow production (live GST portal)

fields.description: Queue a push to cloud (as a DRAFT) when a Sales Invoice of a mapped company is submitted. E-invoice / e-way bill are never generated automatically.
fields.label: Auto-push on submit

fields.description: Off (default): when an invoice is found cancelled on the cloud site, AITS GST Managers are notified and the invoice shows a 'Cancel here too' button. On: the local invoice is cancelled automatically by a background job (reverses its accounting entries).
fields.label: Auto-cancel local invoice when cancelled on cloud

fields.description: Pushed invoices whose cloud status is polled: posted within this many days.
fields.label: Status Sync Look-back (days)

fields.description: Failed pushes (network errors, cloud 5xx) are retried with exponential backoff: 5, 10, 20, 40, 80 minutes.
fields.label: Max Push Retries

fields.description: Optional. Set the same secret on the cloud Webhook (Sales Invoice, on update) pointing to /api/method/aitsgst.api.cloud_webhook. The webhook only triggers a re-read from cloud; its payload is never trusted.
fields.label: Webhook Secret

fields.description: Only needed where a template's name differs between local and cloud; otherwise the local name is used as-is.
fields.label: Tax Template Map
